_doc.about: Machine paths for tools/pipeline.py on machine B, house0305 SOP loop. Copy to pipeline.json (or pass --pipeline-config) and edit. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
_doc.run_root: RUN in the cmd scripts: holds <arm>.json configs, <arm>/ outputs, arm_scores.txt, queue_status.txt, delivery_<tag>/
_doc.repo_root: checkout whose tools/ run and that goes first on PYTHONPATH; identity_dir is relative to it. Omit to use the checkout containing pipeline.py
_doc.python: interpreter with torch + gsplat (the training venv)
_doc.env_script: cmd file `call`ed once; its variables feed every subprocess (CUDA/JIT cache pins). Omit to inherit the current environment
_doc.reference_ply: competitor delivery used as pseudo ground truth by the three-way and off-trajectory strips
_doc.reference_alignment: JSON with the rigid 'transform' bringing reference_ply into our frame
_doc.tile_inputs_root: root the tile manifest paths resolve against
_doc.exports_dir: where delivery body/sky PLYs are published
_doc.delivery_eval_config: evaluation config for the merged model (battery, matched strips)
_doc.sky_ply: frozen sky layer copied beside every delivery body PLY
_doc.delivery_tiles: tiles trained per delivery; tile arm names follow delivery_tile_arm_pattern
_doc.delivery_baselines: earlier deliveries scored beside a new one; relative paths resolve against run_root
_doc.trainer_process_pattern: substring of a live command line that means 'a trainer holds the GPU' (secondary check behind the gpu.lock lease)
_doc.gpu_device: device id recorded in <run_root>/gpu.lock by every GPU step
_doc.env: extra environment variables for every subprocess
